text:
maria: quick Q — for the /v1/generate contract, how should we treat `model_hint` vs `model_id`? is `model_hint` only a preference (best-effort) or can callers expect strict selection if available? also how do region/tier hints interact with fallback order?

sam: `model_id` is strict — server should pick that exact model or return 404/400. `model_hint` is a preference: runtime should try to honor it but may route to compatible variants. region/tier hints are used as routing hints, not selectors. if capacity unavailable in requested region/tier, we fall back per policy (region -> tier -> compatible model).

lee: example behavior request/response snippet that contracts team can land on:
```json
// request
{
  "input": "...",
  "model_hint": "rwkv-7b-v2",
  "routing_hints": {"region": "us-west-2", "tier": "dedicated"}
}
// response metadata
{
  "chosen_model": "rwkv-7b-v2-quant",
  "fallback_chain": ["rwkv-7b-v2", "rwkv-7b-v2-quant", "rwkv-6b-compat"],
  "routing": {"region": "us-west-2", "tier": "standard"}
}
```
This makes fallback explicit for clients that want to surface why a different model was used.

maria: thats helpful. is `fallback_chain` required by contract or optional? i worry about tight coupling for mobile apps showing exactly why they got a cheaper model.

sam: prefer optional but recommended. contract should guarantee `chosen_model` always present. `fallback_chain` can be present when useful; we should document semantics: ordered list from requested -> final. consider a `fallback_reason` short enum (e.g., `capacity`, `compatibility`, `quota`).

jamal: flagging a couple follow-ups for the API team:
- add `chosen_model` required field to the spec
- declare `fallback_chain` and `fallback_reason` as optional diagnostic fields
- clarify that `routing_hints` are advisory and may be ignored if incompatible
I'll open a minimal PR with spec change + unit tests.

nisha: CI note: @jamal your last PR (#1829) failed the contract-lint job — it enforces that all responses include `metadata: {}` even if empty. that caused tests to fail in staging. worth updating tests to accept optional `fallback_chain`.

ci-bot: build #4821 for jamal/api-fallback-spec — contract-lint failed (missing metadata.fallback_chain rule) — https://ci.internal/runs/4821 :x:

jamal: thanks, will update tests. @sam @maria can one of you review the PR when i add the spec change? aiming to get this into beta before next release. :eyes:

sam: happy to review, ping me with the link. also propose we add a small integration smoke that simulates region failover and asserts the `fallback_chain` ordering.

lee: small nit — wording in docs: say "routing_hints are advisory" not "best-effort". less ambiguous for compliance teams.

maria: agreed. last thing: mobile SDKs need a deterministic short field `model_display` (string) so they can show what model label to show in UI even if `chosen_model` is a variant. add to spec?

jamal: will add `model_display` (nullable) to response metadata. thanks all — i'll update PR and tag reviewers. :shipit:

ci-bot: build queued for jamal/api-fallback-spec after push — #4822 :white_check_mark:

maria: added to calendar — quick sync tomorrow 10am PT if we need to finalize language.

sam: okay — thanks folks, sounds like a solid plan.
